about: Global numbers and the three acts. Each row is one rule.

rows.desc: Cards every run starts with on the home board (plus 3 of the ethic's worker card).
How many worker cards (Pop or Drone) a run starts with.
Act 2 (Guardians) starts this moon: Frontier and Strategic packs unlock and 3 Guardian Signals appear.
Act 3 (Crisis) starts this moon: the crisis rift opens on the home board.
Moons after the rift opens until the crisis boss arrives (sooner if the rift is destroyed).
From moon 3, every N moons a Pirate Raider arrives on the home board.
A hostile card with no battle picks a fight with a nearby card this often.
Unfed Pops simply die at moon end (no corpse card).
Drop cards here to sell them for their value in Energy.
